description: Free discovery tool. Get supported public master-data entity types, identifiers, searchable attributes, relationships, reference domains, coverage, and freshness. Use this first when an agent does not know the data model or valid filters.

entityType.description: One of the v1 entity domains. customer, asset, and person are closed Operator decisions, not gaps; reference data is served by get_reference_data.

inputSchema.description: Input for the free discovery tool that describes the published master-data schema: entity domains, identifiers, attributes, and relationships. Every property is optional: an empty object returns the full schema for all v1 entity domains.

entity_type.description: Describe only this entity domain. Omitted means all v1 entity domains.

include_attributes.description: When false, the attributes member is omitted from each described entity type.

include_identifiers.description: When false, the identifiers member is omitted from each described entity type. primary_identifier is always present.

include_relationships.description: When false, the relationships member is omitted from each described entity type.

inputSchema.title: get_master_data_schema tool input

name: get_master_data_schema
title: Get Master Data Schema
